summary: Comprehensive, production-grade implementation plan for the VU Smart Deadline Manager covering data models, storage (IndexedDB/Dexie + SQLite abstraction), reminder engine (thresholds, snooze math, 10s undo, .ics export), secure Gemini serverless extraction with Zod schemas, duplicate detection, dark-navy electric-blue UI/UX, and 5-stage delivery plan with test reporting.
